title: Energy-gap--controlled current oscillations in graphene under periodic driving
summary: We investigate the impact of an induced mass term $Δ$ on the current density in graphene subjected to a space- and time-dependent periodic potential $U(x,t)$. By solving the Dirac equation and deriving both the quasi-energy spectrum and the corresponding eigenspinors, we obtain explicit analytical expressions for the current density, which exhibits a clear dependence on $Δ$. We show that $Δ$ acts as a tunable control parameter that governs the amplitude, sign, and resonance structure of Josephson-like current oscillations.
